researches.title: Quantum Switch Scheduling for Shared Users: Age Objectives, Memory Limits, and Rate Constraints
researches.question: Has any published work scheduled entanglement distribution at a quantum switch or hub that serves two bipartite requests sharing one user (for example A–B and A–C), where the hub chooses the swap partner from the age of the stored link, minimizes the age of entanglement under a memory cutoff, and adds a long-run delivery-rate floor and an attempt budget? Has this been studied for underwater optical quantum links?
